summary: Frontend-only visual/layout regression for LOKAGER Module 0 launch ceremony. Verified new SVG wordmark and cinematic side-panel layout at 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1366x768, plus mobile 390x844 and tablet 820x1180. Wordmark refactor to inline SVG is correct across all 4 usages; centring is pixel-perfect. Side panels look great at 1920 and 1440; on 1366x768 the panel is slightly below the 60% target (59.6%) and the page produces ~101px vertical scroll (exceeds the 24px tolerance). All scene images load, captions gate correctly, scenes 19-20 panels fade out, celebration and coming-soon screens reached, no console errors, no /api requests.

ui_bugs.issue: documentElement.scrollHeight=869 vs viewport 768 = 101px vertical scroll (spec requires <=24px). Panel height also computes to 458/768=59.6% (spec: 60-85%). Reason: min(76dvh, 100dvh-310px)=458 works, but header pt-12 + countdown (~210px) + message + brand-strip footer pb-9 exceed 768. Consider tightening 310px reserve, reducing header/footer padding at lg breakpoint, or using 100dvh-260px at that breakpoint.

document_scroll_vs_viewport.1366x768: sh=869 vs vh=768 (101px, FAIL - exceeds 24px tolerance)

action_items: Fix 1366x768 layout: page currently scrolls ~101px vertically and panel is 59.6% (below 60% threshold). Options: reduce the 310px reserve in `h-[min(76dvh,calc(100dvh-310px))]` to ~260px at lg only, or shrink header/footer vertical padding at lg breakpoint, or drop CountdownNumber's fixed height slightly. Aim: sh<=vh+24 AND panel>=60% at 1366x768.
critical_code_review_comments: CountdownScreen SidePanel uses `100dvh-310px` reserve which assumes a taller viewport; at 768px this collapses panel to 59.6% and still overflows because header+timer+message+brand-strip exceed the remainder. Consider a responsive reserve (e.g., 260px @ lg, 310px @ xl+).

SceneVisual Frame has `-inset-2.5 sm:-inset-3.5` decorative border that extends beyond bounds; harmless but worth verifying it doesn't leak past viewport at 1366px (currently panels have x=56 left/x=983 right, safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 focused on visual layout of the new cinematic side panels and the inline-SVG wordmark. Panels/wordmark are correct at 1920 and 1440; the only measurable regression is at 1366x768 (panel 59.6% and 101px vertical scroll). Mobile & tablet variants are correct. All 20 scene images (Unsplash) load. Timing (60s -> celebration -> +9s coming-soon) verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: At 1366x768, SidePanel height = min(76dvh=583.68, 100dvh-310px=458) = 458 (59.6%). Above/below the main grid the header (pt-12 ~= 48px + logo ~= 100px), countdown block (eyebrow+beginsIn+number 210px+unit label ~= 300px) and footer (BrandStrip 41px + pb-9=36px) plus vertical padding push total content to ~869px, forcing 101px scroll. Fix by lowering the fixed 310px offset at lg breakpoint or reducing pt-12/pb-9.
